decisions.title: Fort Sumter, spring 1861
decisions.question: What would you do about the fort?

options.text: Withdraw the garrison from Fort Sumter.
Try to bring more troops into the fort.
Send food to the garrison, and land troops only if the supply ships are fired on.

decisions.title: Buying Louisiana, 1803
decisions.question: What would you do about the Constitution?

options.text: Ask for a constitutional amendment before going ahead.
Send the treaty to the Senate for approval without waiting for an amendment.

decisions.title: Washington and a second term, 1792
decisions.question: What would you do when the first term ends?

options.text: Retire after one term, as he had planned.
